description: Use Feeding America’s locator to find a food bank serving your community and ask where to obtain food from its partner pantries or distributions.
introduction: Use Feeding America’s locator to find a food bank serving your community and ask where to obtain food from its partner pantries or distributions.

who: People who need help affording food can look for local food assistance. Some providers have residence or other local requirements.
sections.get: Food banks distribute food through a network of community partners. The local bank can direct you to a pantry or distribution where individuals receive food.
sections.docs: Before visiting, ask the distribution site about identification, household information and any local requirements. Check opening hours and whether an appointment is needed; the warehouse address may not be a public pickup location.
sections.apply: Enter your ZIP code in the food bank locator, then contact the listed bank for nearby pantry and distribution information.
sections.after: Confirm the pickup location and schedule directly. Tell the provider about transportation or dietary needs. Ask when you may return and what to do if a scheduled distribution is cancelled.
sections.sources:
• Feeding America locator
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Should I go directly to the food bank warehouse?
Contact it first. A partner pantry or distribution may be the correct pickup location.
Does the locator enroll me in SNAP?
No. It locates food banks; SNAP has a separate application.
Must every pantry follow identical rules?
No. Ask your chosen site about its local requirements.
What if I cannot travel to the location?
Ask the bank about another distribution or local delivery options; availability varies.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
